Mmhmm! Look at that color~! Looks so yummy♪
—Wait, I shouldn't forage too much from just one spot!

Even though we must've covered dozens of kilometers today, Hishi Akebono
cheerfully dashes ahead. Her broad back gets smaller and smaller into the distance.
It's always been my dream to go together with my Trainer~.
It all started a few days ago.

Ahaha! We gathered so much, it's gotta be pretty heavy, huh~!
Leave the carrying to me~.
Yay~! I caught an even bigger one!
(Oink!)

All the ingredients gathered with such care were gone, and now we were stranded camping out in the middle of nowhere.
Even for someone as tough as Hishi Akebono, this had to take a toll. Or so I thought—

After hiking through five mountains, our pack baskets were overflowing with wild vegetables and mushrooms.
I tried giving it a lift, but—

Without showing the slightest hint of fatigue or disappointment,
Hishi Akebono hops around cheerfully with a bright smile.

No, no way, I must be seeing things—wait... what...?
She really is catching sea bass with her bare hands...
—Whoa! Look, look, Trainer! The starry sky is so pretty!
—Wait, huh? Is it... charging right this way...?

Aww, did they replace the timetable?
It's different from when we got off. Sorry about that, Trainer.

Well, days like this happen! Oh, right, the rice
and canned food we brought are still safe, so let's make seasoned rice with it☆

Umm... looks like the first train is at 6:00 AM.
Which means we've got 12 hours left~. What a pickle!

No way! Your health is way more important, Trainer.
Besides, we can definitely just buy meat, so don't you worry one bit~♪
However—

Maybe we should check out the next mountain over!
Come on, Trainer, hurry, hurry~♪

It's a little far, but the scenery is gorgeous and totally worth it~!
So let's get going☆

Yep! There's a butcher shop that sells really amazing ground chicken,
and it's an absolute must for chanko nabe~.

With that, Hishi Akebono hoisted the basket that wouldn't budge an inch for me
like it was nothing, and cheerfully dashed off ahead.
Alrighty, I think that does it~. Should we head to the sea next~?

I dragged down the nearby pack basket filled with our ingredients with me
and tumbled straight into the river...
(Rumble rumble rumble!)
Ehehe, it's not every day you get to camp outdoors, so it's kinda fun♪
And to make matters worse—

Eep?! W-W-Whoa~!
Trainer, watch out~!
Whoa! It's a little wild boar! So cute~!

One weekend, some time after becoming Hishi Akebono's Trainer
following our encounter on the deserted island.
Wait... is that girl catching sea bass with her bare hands?!
Well then, let's head to the butcher shop~.

Luckily neither of us was hurt, but all the ingredients
Hishi Akebono had run all over to gather were washed away down the river...
Camping out, huh~!

I couldn't just let her sleep out in the open. I explained the situation to the academy
and scrambled to find lodging. But I couldn't find a single vacancy—

After transferring trains for about an hour, we finally arrived out in the countryside.
However... a cascade of misfortunes was waiting for us!

Mmm~! The air smells so fresh and good.
Wait, huh, is that a wild boar...?!
Ah! I spotted an even biiiigger fish~! I'm on it!
Oh dear~! Temporarily closed...?!

I figured we'd probably visit her favorite grocers or fish markets. But my expectations
were completely shattered, and before I knew it, we were foraging for mushrooms in the mountains.
The last bus has already left!

If you're free this weekend, wanna go on an outing?
I want to gather ingredients to make chanko nabe~.

Caught completely off guard, I was too slow to react.
I scrambled to dodge, but lost my footing—
—Aaaand hup☆
The night sky her long arm pointed to was indeed breathtakingly gorgeous.

Caught a big sea bass! Trainer, please keep an eye
on the cooler box, okay? There are lots of kitties around here.
Are you okay, Trainer?!
Heeeyaaah!

Like that, we dashed from mountain to sea, gathering plenty of ingredients.
Just as my stamina was hitting its absolute limit and I was about to suggest heading home—
